changes.summary: Execute the frozen contract checks against exactly the applied resulting snapshot. Missing, unsupported, inconclusive, timed-out or failing required checks never become passed.
Record accepted only for a verification whose required set all passed and whose resulting snapshot still matches the workspace.
List verification summaries, optionally scoped to one ChangeSet.

verification.snapshot_binding: the ChangeSet resulting_snapshot_id; a staged or older snapshot is rejected
verification.contract_binding: frozen contract digest recorded on the ChangeSet
verification.toolchain_binding: toolchain_digest recorded on the ChangeSet and present in the CAS
verification.acceptance: every required check passed, no missing/extra results, no snapshot drift
verification.executor: argv without shell, environment allowlist, bounded output, declared timeout, process-tree cleanup, optional per-check snapshot-copy sandbox
verification.retry: none; timed_out is final for that check

predicates.exit_code: expected_codes non-empty; actual exit code must be a member
predicates.test_report: format junit|json, report_path, min_tests >= 1, failures+errors <= max_failures, command exit 0
predicates.file_digest: path in the verified snapshot plus expected_digest
predicates.architecture_rules: architecture_id, optional revision/rule_ids; partial static coverage is inconclusive, violations/blocked are failed

modes.workspace_copy: materialize the selected files from the verified resulting snapshot into a ledger-owned copy; cwd and predicates stay inside it
modes.workspace: explicitly no isolation; recorded as isolated=false
modes.container: materialize the selected snapshot files, mount the copy at /workspace in a pinned Linux container with --network none, a read-only root and a 64 MiB /tmp tmpfs

fields.include: non-empty for workspace_copy; relative POSIX file or directory prefixes
fields.image: required for container; name@sha256:... or a local sha256:<id>, verified against the local image and never pulled
fields.network: optional for container; only "none" is accepted

checks[].sandbox.validation: rejects undeclared command checks, checker-only sandbox, workspace mode with include/exclude, workspace_copy without include, container without a digest-pinned image, non-"none" container network, and image/network fields on non-container modes
checks[].sandbox.limitation: workspace_copy is a materialized allowlist; container is Docker/Linux-only and runs as the image default user; scenario execution uses the shared modes in ADR-051
checks[].sandbox.required_for: new contract proposals with a command check must declare workspace_copy or workspace; frozen legacy contracts without the field are recorded as declared=false
